data.text:
**Visual Quality Review (320×568) — Result: No concrete issues found**

- **Text overflow/clipping:** None. "Şevbaş, Rojda!", the daily lesson card ("Dersê rojane", "5 pirs • nêzîkî 3 deqe"), and the button "Dest pê bike →" all fit within the narrow width.
- **Bottom navigation:** All four labels ("Hîn Bibe", "Pêşbazî", "Rêzbendî", "Profil") render fully without truncation at 320px.
- **Contrast:** Readable throughout — white text on the orange card and dark green header is clear; the muted "Ast" label on the dark card remains legible.
- **Overlap:** No overlapping elements; the bottom nav does not obscure any visible content.
- **Primary action:** The main CTA ("Dest pê bike →") is fully visible and tappable without scrolling.

The layout adapts well to the narrow screen.
